_about: Intent and causal wording that never appears in claims, templates, UI text, phraser prompts or phraser outputs. Event data shows what was recorded, not why. Matched case-insensitively on whole words (a phrase matches as a whole). Used by tests/test_banned_language.py (template linter), agents/output_guard.py (model replies) and tools/check_web.py (rendered UI). Use observational verbs instead: recorded, played, switched, won back, conceded, completed.
